messages:
Diego (CSM): Heads up 10-seat preview for Aether starting next week. Main asks: role-based access for their team and an onboarding checklist we can hand to their onboarding PM. Also they flagged document deduping as a must-have. Who can walk dedupe logic?

Priya (Solutions Eng): I can run dedupe walkthrough. We should capture their dedupe tolerance (fpr/recall tradeoff). I'll prepare a short demo script and sample match thresholds.

Rosa (CS Ops): I'll build the onboarding checklist. Can we standardize that PMs get a "who to contact" quicklist and a post-kickoff 7-day check?

Diego (CSM): Yes. Also they're worried about renewal: if dedupe doesn't meet their 95% reduction target their CFO will balk. Let's put a milestone: day 4 dedupe QA with their data sample.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Proposal: run local dedupe pass on 10k sample, report precision@thresholds and recall. If precision@0.9 < 0.85 then we iterate config.

Rosa (CS Ops): Ops needs a temp workspace with RBAC and 3 user seats for their team. @ops-bot can you provision workspace with role groups dev/pm/ops?

ops-bot: Ticket #CS-9205 created. Provisioning workspace with RBAC groups dev/pm/ops; ETA 48h.

Diego (CSM): Timeline:
- Wed: kickoff + dedupe demo (Priya)
- Thu: workspace provisioned (ops-bot)
- Day 4: dedupe QA with customer sample (Priya/Rosa)
- Day 7: check-in and NPS single question pulse (Diego)
Please ack.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Ack. I'll prep the demo and thresholds doc.

Rosa (CS Ops): Ack. I'll add the post-kickoff 7-day check to checklist.

Diego (CSM): If dedupe fails to hit the threshold on day 4, fallback: run our dedupe pipeline with higher recall params and schedule a follow-up triage with their data science lead.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Sounds good. I'll also include a short how-to for tweaking match thresholds in the UI.

Diego (CSM): Thanks team :pray:
